name: @atlasauth/pca-mpc-wasm
description: Constant-time Ed25519 base-OT curve core (curve25519-dalek, compiled to WebAssembly): a drop-in, genuinely constant-time replacement for @atlasauth/pca-mpc's pure-BigInt ec.ts curve ops, closing the JS/runtime constant-time boundary of docs §7.1.

scripts.build:wasm: cd crate && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pca_mpc_wasm.wasm ../wasm/pca_mpc_wasm.wasm
